newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 31.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 31.

text.p: All major ports were open as of 1000 local/1600 GMT to large vessels, the Communications and Transportation Ministry said in a daily update.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

High pressure will tend to clear skies in the area, although entry of damp tropical air could lead to overcast skies along the coast of Baja California, Sonora, Sinaloa, Nayarit, Jalisco, Colima, Michoacan, Guerrero and Oaxaca states. Prevailing winds will be from northeast of 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour) with waves of three feet high.

Moderate convection from west and damp tropical air bringing light overcast skies along the coast of Veracruz and Tabasco states and the Yucatan peninsula. Prevailing winds from southeast of 10 to 15 knots with waves of three to five feet high.
Entry of damp tropical air bringing light overcast skies on the coast of Quintana Roo state. Prevailing winds from the east and northeast at 10 to 15 knots with waves three to five feet high.
